Inspect and repair Pomme-owned durable agent workflows.

```text
pomme agent SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme agent status

Show durable agent workflow status.

```text
pomme agent status NAME [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Pomme-owned VM name. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme agent repair

Repair a Pomme-owned agent workflow and restore its prior state.

```text
pomme agent repair NAME [--final-state FINAL_STATE] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Pomme-owned VM name. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--final-state FINAL_STATE` | Final VM state: previous. Values: `previous`. Default: `previous`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
